# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

if [ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ]; then

  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f#"$dir/$name."}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    if [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ]; then rm -f -- "$f"; fi
  done
}

# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
case $keep in
  ''|*[!0-9]*|0) echo "rotate: invalid keep in config/rotate.conf: '$keep'" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/archive.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp>: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>.
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"
}


# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep only the newest <keep> name.<YYYYMMDD>.
prune_archive() {
  local archive=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f i=0 files=()
  for f in "$archive/$name".[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]; do
    [ -e "$f" ] && files+=("$f")
  done
  # glob order is ascending by stamp; walk from newest
  for ((j=${#files[@]}-1; j>=0; j--)); do
    i=$((i + 1))
    [ "$i" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "${files[j]}"
  done
}

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".[0-9]*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in *[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
}

. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".[0-9]*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in *[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -1)
keep=${keep:-3}
rotate_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$keep"

lib/archive.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp> [keep]: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>,
# then keep only the newest <keep> name.<stamp> files in the archive dir.
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4 keep=$5 f
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"
  [ -n "$keep" ] || return 0
  for f in "$archive/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    case ${f##*.} in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "${f%.*}" = "$archive/$name" ] && echo "$f"
  done | sort -r | tail -n +"$((keep + 1))" | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f"; done
}

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name> [keep]: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  if [ -n "$keep" ]; then prune_local "$dir" "$name" "$keep"; fi
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "${f%.*}" = "$dir/$name" ] || continue
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
}
